title: Anthony Scopatz - xonsh - PyCon 2016
summary: Anthony Scopatz presents xonsh at PyCon 2016, a shell that is a superset of Python combining the best features of bash, zsh and fish. It covers rich history, tab completion, and how the language compiles to a Python AST.
why: Recommended as the author's own explanation of xonsh's design and how Python and shell interplay.

quote.text: It's very easy to switch if you're willing to spend 30 minutes to go through this talk about its design by the author
